notes:
PR template is already well-structured. Analysis summary:

1. **Readability**: HTML comments are clear and helpful. Section order is logical (Overview -> Related Issue -> Change Type -> Changes -> Testing -> Screenshots -> Reviewer Notes -> Checklist). Instructions are easy to follow.

2. **Consistency**: Checkbox formats are consistent (all use `- [ ]`). Header levels are consistent (`##` for main sections, `###` for subsections). Terminology aligns with 04-quality-standards.md and 08-issue-split.md.

3. **Whitespace and formatting**: Clean formatting with appropriate spacing. No unnecessary blank lines detected.

4. **Content completeness**: All necessary sections included. Skip conditions (docs-only, internal, test-only, ci-only) match 04-quality-standards.md. Test hierarchy (L1-L4) properly documented. Layer confirmation section aligns with 08-issue-split.md single-layer rule. Cross-layer label guidance included.

5. **Alignment verification**: Unit test 90% threshold matches docs. Integration test 50% threshold matches docs. PO acceptance test (L4) conditions documented. Skip reasons match quality standards.

No changes needed as the template meets all quality criteria and maintains consistency with related documentation.
